# SoraIconButton

A square button that shows only an icon and therefore requires an accessible name.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | actions |
| Import | `import { SoraIconButton } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraIconButton from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraIconButton'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/actions/SoraIconButton.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/actions/SoraIconButton.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` **(required)** | `string` |  | Accessible name. Required: an icon alone does not name a control. |
| `icon` | `SoraIconDefinition` |  | Glyph to show. Use the default slot for custom content instead. |
| `variant` | `SoraVariant` |  | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` |  | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Custom decorative content. It must not carry its own accessible name. |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus` | method |  |
| `element` | property |  |

## Attributes

The native `<button>` (through SoraButton).

## Keyboard

- Enter or Space activates (native).

## Accessibility

- `label` is required and becomes `aria-label`.
- The icon is decorative.
- Coarse pointers get a 44px hit area.

## Styling

- `.sora-button.sora-icon-button`
- `data-variant`, `data-color`, `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.search')" :icon="iconSearch" />
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.add')" :icon="iconPlus" variant="outline" />
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.more')" :icon="iconMore" variant="soft" size="sm" />
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.add')" :icon="iconPlus" variant="solid" color="primary" size="lg" />
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.search')" :icon="iconSearch" loading />
  <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.search')" :icon="iconSearch" disabled />
</div>
```
